metrics.note: Uncalibrated run with simplified physics (presTemp upper BC, simpleResistance stomatal, BeersLaw radiation). High volume bias expected - model needs calibration and full energy balance for accurate Q.

issues: vGn_alpha must be NEGATIVE in SUMMA (sign convention for matric head) - KI tool generates positive values, causing NaN
MPTABLE.TBL from case_study/base_settings is needed for MODIFIED_IGBP_MODIS_NOAH - ghost_river copies only had USGS section
KI default decisions have incompatibility: groundwatr=qTopmodl requires bcLowrSoiH=zeroFlux but KI sets drainage
KI default fDerivMeth=numericl fails with 'cross derivatives' error when using mixdform+nrg_flux
forcingFileList.txt generated with quotes around filenames - not needed (SUMMA strips them but inconsistent with working examples)
Had to use presTemp upper BC instead of nrg_flux to avoid convergence issues on this subtropical basin
ki_gaps: CRITICAL: set_trial_parameters.py PARAM_RANGES for vGn_alpha says (0.001, 10.0) but SUMMA expects NEGATIVE values. This caused NaN on every run until fixed. The tool should either negate the value or document the sign convention.
configure_decisions.py INCOMPATIBILITIES list missing: groundwatr=qTopmodl requires bcLowrSoiH=zeroFlux. SUMMA crashes with explicit error but KI should catch this before running.
configure_decisions.py INCOMPATIBILITIES list missing: fDerivMeth=numericl is incompatible with mixdform+nrg_flux (cross-derivative issue).
convert_vic_forcing_to_summa.py writes forcingFileList.txt with quoted filenames ('file.nc') - should write unquoted (file.nc) to match SUMMA convention.
create_file_manager.py should verify MPTABLE.TBL contains the section matching vegeParTbl decision (e.g., MODIFIED_IGBP_MODIS_NOAH section must exist if that table is selected).
KI does not document that SUMMA base_settings/ directory contains the canonical parameter tables - user may copy tables from other runs that lack needed sections.
KI SKILL.md default decisions (DEFAULT_DECISIONS in configure_decisions.py) contain mutually incompatible options (drainage + qTopmodl). The safe defaults should be self-consistent.
No guidance in KI for choosing vGn_alpha values for different soil types. Belly_river reference values (-1.5, -0.8, -0.6) should be documented.
